subject: A causal evidence workbench for a reusable residual direction and actual agent tool review
audience: Teams shipping fine-tuned models and reviewers assessing the experimental evidence

type.body: Aptos, then Segoe UI, for readable application controls
type.data: the body font with tabular numerals; monospace only for hashes and raw responses

layout: Fixed development-mean intervention leads with exact before/after generated responses and failed validation gate. Supporting matched-transplant controls, development layer sweep, and six actual OpenAI-chosen Agent37 tool calls remain inspectable.
wireframe: [causal finding and strict gate outcome] [actual block-19 residual transplant] [repair/reverse and scored/generated controls] [norm-matched arms] [development layer sweep] [real intervened generations] [frozen protocol and limits]
principles: Lead with actual internal interventions; distinguish measured primary repair from the failed all-arm frozen gate and nonspecific reverse insertion.
Spend visual emphasis on the one edited referral field and its divergent decision.
Distinguish recorded inference, deterministic audit selection, and pending independent work.
Every number is extracted from raw reports; downloading evidence is a real action.
Keep model scope, ordinary accuracy, negative controls, and failed experiments visible.
Use keyboard-accessible native controls, responsive layout, and reduced-motion support.
self_review: Reviewed desktop and390px mobile. Zero mobile overflow, no console errors. Real generated answers, raw tensors, complete controls and original failed gates are visible. Agent review is explicitly read-only recorded evidence; GPU experiments are human-orchestrated.
